restrictions: The two messages have 1024t + 55 and 1024t + 63 bytes for one t with 1 <= t < 2^32: t zero chunks of 1024 bytes followed by a last chunk of one block. The last chunk is compressed as a non-root chunk with counter t (v12 = t, v13 = 0), flags 3 and its true block length; the 63-byte block ends in eight zero bytes, so words 14 and 15 and the top byte of word 13 are zero in both zero-filled blocks. Equal last-chunk chaining values give equal digests by the tree lemma of proof.md Section 7.
Unkeyed BLAKE3-256 with 2 prefix rounds, standard IV, permutation and feed-forward, full 256-bit digest; an ordinary collision between two distinct complete messages.

Exact part: for every trial of proof.md Section 8 the two last-chunk chaining values agree on words 0, 2, 5 and 7, E1.c1 lies in the cube of beta* = 18b0e098 so that beta = beta* in every trial, Y4 ranges over the whole class of eta (524,288 values; no sub-class, no rule on h1), and the counter t is solved per trial as ROL(K0.d1,16) XOR K0.a1; trials with t = 0 are skipped. Only outer steps that pass the exact filter of Section 8 for S = {175,185,275,285,385,685}020a0 and the exact s-pattern pre-check reach the solver. It follows the one path of the static slot named by four fresh selector bits of the step's word, with bit 15 of the root fixed by the exact guard (G15) (proof.md 9.8), and certifies at most one trial: each listed success of a step owns exactly one of 16 slots (Lemmas F, VP, G7, G15, SL), so a step certifies one with probability exactly N/16. Heuristic part: 2^94.460 walked trials (2^73.460 outer steps of 2^21) give a collision with probability at least 0.39 under H1' alone.

Classical 256-bit word RAM under collision-frontier-v5, 430 machine units (operations, loads, stores) per unit, on a 64-register load/store machine with immediate constants; a memory fetch costs one load. Outer steps run seven to a batch in lean packed 36-bit lanes, the filter's masks read from two direct tables of 2^32 words built once (2^39 units; proof.md 9.10, Lemma TAB): 341 units per batch, 13 per lane whose test-(2) mask meets S, 512 per passing lane, and 8,936 for the slot selection, the one-path solver of proof.md 9.8 with (G7) and (G15) and the sparse certificate of its root (Lemma SC) when the pre-check keeps the step: proved upper allowances of a specified layout. No sorting, no table that grows with the trials. The run halts with failure when the test-(2), pass or solver count exceeds L = ceil(855 RUN_STEPS / 2048) + ceil(sqrt(5 RUN_STEPS)), or after RUN_BATCHES batches; each row is charged at L plus one, and no mean of a work count is used (proof.md Section 11).

Randomized by eight fresh uniform 256-bit words per batch of seven outer steps; each outer step reads its own disjoint bits, its selector from bits 0, 1, 8 and 9 of its eighth word (Lemma PL). Success 0.39 holds only under H1' (a mean rate, no dependence clause), for the stated advice; a budget halts the run with probability below 0.0005 (Lemma BUD, proved). The factor 98,937,639,497 in H1' is five sevenths of the model count of S on the class, rounded down, and is not measured by the organizer-run experiments, which run the root instance (counter 0, flags 11): no digest experiment can show a half-collision of a non-root chunk. Filter, pre-check, guards, certificate and slots are exact. No full 2-round collision is exhibited. The submitted program runs this search with the slots of proof.md 9.8 on the root instance only, where a root is a collision only if its forced counter word is 0, and counts by the automata's ledger of Section 11; its run length and budgets are shorter, never reached in a trial.

Fixed nonuniform advice stated in proof.md Section 12 (73 bytes): six 32-bit constants, the word eta, the beta* cube (beta*, mask, value), the seven tau values and eps of the filter's automata and the mask of S. The success bound is proved for these stated values from properties proof.md checks exactly (Lemma ADV), however they were found. The selection procedure SEL that found them (proof.md Section 12: 116 solver runs capped at 2^56 operations each, one count per model capped at 2^52 + 2^10, the choice of S capped at 2^50) is charged in full in time_log2, S_old = 8,882,224,365,081,579,520 operations; every run halts at its cap, so the charge holds by construction, with no premise. preprocessing_log2 55 covers SEL and all once-only work (below 2^54.198 units). memory_log2_bytes 44 covers output (below 2^43 bytes), code, advice, search with tables (below 2^39) and every run of SEL (below 2^35), held at once. No priority or novelty claim is made.

heuristics.statement: Score-critical; a mean rate only. Over the run's RUN_STEPS independent uniform 256-bit words, let N_o be the number of listed good valid trials of one outer step (t != 0, R = 0, and an E1 outcome in S = {175,185,275,285,385,685}020a0, six outcomes of beta*; Y4 in the whole class of eta; no rule on h1), counted over all of Q* whether or not the outer step passes the filter or the pre-check. Rate: E[N_o] >= (2^21 - 1) q with q = FACTOR * 2^-128, FACTOR = floor(5 * 138,512,695,296 / 7) = 98,937,639,497, about 2^-91.474 (just under five sevenths of the conditional model rate p of Lemma S1 for S). Nothing else is assumed about N_o: no clause on how the listed good trials of one outer step depend on each other and no bound on its factorial ratio. The search certifies at most one trial per outer step, the one of the static slot named by four fresh selector bits, and every listed good trial of a step owns exactly one of 16 slots (the guard (G15) prescribes bit 15 of its root, Lemma G15), so the certified count N_16 is 0 or 1 with E[N_16] = E[N_o] / 16 exactly, whatever the joint law of the trials (Lemma SL); with RUN_STEPS = ceil(0.49512 * 16 * 2^128 / (FACTOR (2^21 - 1))) the run fails to certify a trial with probability at most exp(-0.49512) (proof.md 10.4). By Lemma F every listed good trial lies in an outer step that passes the filter, and by Lemmas VP, G7 and G15 the pre-check and the guards skip none, so N_o is the same count, pointwise.
heuristics.scope: Exactly the trials of proof.md Sections 8 and 9: lengths 1024t + 55 and 1024t + 63 with a non-root last chunk (counter t, v13 = 0, flags 3), the six constants of Section 3.2, Y4 a member of the whole class of eta (524,288 values, Lemma Q) drawn with the outer words from the run's fresh 256-bit words (seven outer steps to a batch, each on its own disjoint bits, Lemma PL), E1.c1 drawn from the cube of beta* = 18b0e098 in every trial, t solved per trial and t = 0 skipped. N_o counts all of Q* in every outer step and only the six outcomes of S; the clause concerns its mean only. The selector bits, the 16 slots, the guard (G15), the one-path solver and the certificate (proof.md 9.8, Lemma SC) and the direct filter tables (9.10, Lemma TAB) do not change N_o.
heuristics.extrapolation: From the participant's exact count, in integer arithmetic under the seven-word model of Section 10 with Y4 uniform in the class, of the part of beta* on the class carried by the six outcomes of S (67,633,152 = 1,032 * 2^16 on the per-trial scale 2^-83 of the class; the counting program and the six rows of its output are printed in Section 16), times 2^11 for drawing E1.c1 from the cube (Lemma S1), taken at five sevenths, rounded down. The filter, the pre-check, (G7) and (G15) change neither the count nor the premise (Lemmas S9 (b), VP, G7 and G15), and the slots keep exactly 1/16 of the mean (Lemma SL), which the run length pays. Participant evidence of Section 13, untrusted by the harness: a whole-class graphics-card run of 2^46 real counter trials in 2^25 passing outer steps, with a sub-class control of the same size, in which every measured quantity matches the exact model within 1.5 clustered standard errors, among them the E1 rate on the whole class of the seven outcomes of the filter, 1.0020 +- 0.0086 of the model (13,595 events), and its ratio to the sub-class rate, 0.9895 +- 0.0120 (model 1); the E1 event of S is a sub-event of the measured event (52/53 of it in the model) and was not counted on its own; 2^43 real trials inside passing outer steps of the seven-outcome filter on the sub-class, listed E1 outcome 0.979 +- 0.022 of its value; and a reduced-width (8-bit) end-to-end run of complete messages, with no sub-class and no rule, in which the counter arrangement found 251 collisions against 255.0 predicted. The joint 128-bit event itself, about 2^-91 per trial, is not measured at 32 bits.
heuristics.limitations: The factor 98,937,639,497 is assumed (five sevenths of the model count of the six outcomes of S on the class, rounded down); the whole-class mean of N_o for S is declared, not proved. The organizer-run experiments run the root instance (counter 0, flags 11) of the same construction and measure neither the factor nor the counter half-collision, which no digest experiment can show. The transfer of the single-trial law to the actual sampler is partly proved (Lemmas S1-S5, S9, VP, G7, G15) and partly assumed; how much of the success mass the member with t = 0 carries is not proved. The whole-class graphics-card run measures the E1 side of the seven outcomes together and the filter, not the six of S on their own, not the E3 side nor the joint event. Lemma SL needs (PHASE) and (P*) for every joint root; the verifier of proof.md 9.9 certifies both in all eight phases and was run by the participant, not by the organizer. The slot selection, (G15), the one-path solver with its cap of 8,936, the certificate of Lemma SC and the direct filter tables are proved allowances; the submitted program runs their logic on the root instance only, with the automata in place of the tables, step 3 on the compressions and ledger counts, not the 64-register schedule, and has found no root that reached the test t = 0.
